```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.AcceptedAnswerId IS NOT NULL THEN p.Id END) AS DOUBLE) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id), 0) AS adoption_rate
FROM main."posts" p
WHERE p."PostTypeId" = 1
    AND p."CreaionDate" >= DATE '2010-12-01'
    AND p."CreaionDate" < DATE '2011-01-01'
```
